functions: Native, joint invariant, and three each canonical Right/Down/direction shuffles, frozen from H238.
payloads: Actual head write, same-position other-row shuffle, isotropic source-span Gaussian, angle-matched Gaussian. Two sham draws, norm matched per recipient. Angle matching uses each baseline. Other payloads identical across baselines and local functions.

gates.remaining_context_alignment: Removed-baseline rank16 pooled actual-minus-angle gap >=.08 for tangent and full addition; actual-specific native-versus-each-Right interaction >=.05 for both.
gates.self_inclusion_collapse: Intact tangent actual-minus-angle gap >=.08 but absolute removed tangent gap <=.03.
gates.same_secant_chart_retention: Actual full addition at removed baseline has rank16 coverage >=80% of actual full removal at intact baseline, for native. The target vectors must be opposites numerically.

scope: 64 distinct source documents, one random window per document. Document-disjoint from continuation rows17000 onward; cached text may have appeared in older studies. Uniform-document target differs from token-weighted panels. Paired row bootstrap is now paired document bootstrap, conditional on fixed functions/shams and one model. No semantic/downstream-quality claim.
